Now, let's receive the onAddEntry prop in JournalForm. When the form is submitted, we'll call it with the current title and content, then clear the fields.
Then, we'll use onSubmit on the form and prevent the default so the page does not reload.
Now, run the code; type a title and content; then click "Add Entry". The new entry is in the state.
You still only see one card because we haven't rendered the full list yet. And that's a task we'll be tackling very soon in the next lesson.
But first, test yourself with a quiz!
